question: Please provide a list of the top three revenue-generating films for each actor, along with the average revenue per actor in those films, calculated by dividing the total film revenue equally among the actors for each film.
sql:
-- Final query with integer casting for actor_id
WITH film_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        f.film_id,
        f.title,
        SUM(p.amount) as total_revenue
    FROM film f
    JOIN inventory i ON f.film_id = i.film_id
    JOIN rental r ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
    JOIN payment p ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id
    JOIN film_actor fa ON f.film_id = fa.film_id
    GROUP BY f.film_id, f.title
),
film_actor_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        fa.actor_id,
        fr.film_id,
        fr.title,
        fr.total_revenue,
        fr.total_revenue * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fa2.actor_id) 
                                    FROM film_actor fa2 
                                    JOIN film_revenue fr2 ON fa2.film_id = fr2.film_id 
                                    WHERE fr2.film_id = fr.film_id) as revenue_per_actor
    FROM film_revenue fr
    JOIN film_actor fa ON fr.film_id = fa.film_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        a.actor_id,
        a.first_name,
        a.last_name,
        far.film_id,
        far.title,
        far.total_revenue,
        far.revenue_per_actor,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.actor_id ORDER BY far.revenue_per_actor DESC) as rn
    FROM film_actor_revenue far
    JOIN actor a ON far.actor_id = a.actor_id
),
top3 AS (
    SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 3
)
SELECT 
    CAST(actor_id AS INTEGER) as actor_id,
    first_name,
    last_name,
    film_id,
    title,
    total_revenue,
    revenue_per_actor,
    AVG(revenue_per_actor) OVER (PARTITION BY actor_id) as avg_revenue_per_actor
FROM top3
ORDER BY actor_id, rn
